items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: But his brother was Leonce, is that the one?

ctx.x: Yeah, but Manuel was a cornet player, I knew him. But his brother was Leonce, is that the one?
No, this was, I know his name was Molo. He was a dark and plected, big tall fella. And he played nice trombone.
